name: ensemble
author: coldsoldr
description: ENSEMBLE, a stereo chorus that morphs into a string ensemble: te-op1-cfw's kennel effect (ports/knl/ensemble 0.2, coldsoldr), its fixed-point core after Mutable Instruments Rings' and Plaits' ensemble and Clouds' half-rate path (Emilie Gillet, MIT), stereo at every position. Blue rate, green depth, white voices (one copy a side to three), orange mix; fn + blue the input gain of the wet path (-6..+6 dB, shift + fn + blue fine). GPL-3.0-or-later with the OP-1 firmware permission; the DSP's MIT terms in LICENSE-MIT.
